mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( -- 먼저 정렬을 수행할 서브쿼리 SELECT stats_date, SUM(cnt) AS total_count FROM ( SELECT post_date AS stats_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM INSTAGRAM_POST GROUP BY post_date UNION ALL SELECT comment_date AS stats_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM instagram_comment GROUP BY comment_date UNION ALL SELECT published_at AS stats_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM youtube_video GROUP BY published_at UNION ALL SELECT published_at AS stats_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM youtube_comment GROUP BY published_at ) combined GROUP BY stats_date ORDER BY stats_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 7
